name: Gumbo with Chicken and Sausage
steps: Brown the chicken and sausage in oil and set aside.
Soften the onion, pepper, celery and garlic in the same pot.
Add the broth, tomatoes, okra, seasoning and meats and simmer 35 minutes.
Serve over the rice.

name: Seafood Gumbo with Shrimp and Crab
steps: Soften the onion, pepper, celery and garlic in oil.
Add the broth, tomatoes, okra and seasoning and simmer 25 minutes.
Add the shrimp and crab for the last 5 minutes.

name: Crawfish-Style Shrimp Étouffée
steps: Soften the onion, pepper, celery and garlic in butter.
Stir in the paste, broth and seasoning and simmer 12 minutes.
Add the shrimp and cook 4 minutes.
Serve over rice with green onion.

name: Blackened Chicken with Dirty Cauliflower Rice
steps: Coat the chicken in Cajun seasoning and sear in oil, 5 minutes a side.
Brown the turkey with the onion, pepper and celery and add the cauliflower rice.
Serve the sliced chicken over the rice with green onion.

name: Louisiana Red Rice with Smoked Sausage
steps: Brown the sliced sausage in oil.
Add the onion, pepper, celery and garlic and soften.
Stir in the paste, broth and seasoning, then the cooked rice, and heat through.

name: Hoppin' John with Black-Eyed Peas
steps: Simmer the peas with the ham, onion, celery, pepper, garlic and broth for 30 minutes.
Serve over the rice with hot sauce.

name: Smothered Chicken Thighs with Onion Gravy
steps: Season and sear the chicken in oil, then set aside.
Cook the onions slowly in the pan until deep golden.
Add the broth, thyme and arrowroot slurry and simmer to a gravy.
Return the chicken and braise 20 minutes; serve with green beans.

name: Southern Pan-Fried Catfish with Slaw
steps: Dip the catfish in egg, then almond flour mixed with parmesan and seasoning.
Pan-fry in oil 4 minutes a side.
Toss the slaw with yogurt and vinegar and serve alongside.

name: Shrimp Po' Boy Lettuce Boats
steps: Season the shrimp and sear in oil 2 minutes a side.
Mix the mayo, hot sauce and lemon.
Fill the lettuce leaves with shrimp, tomato, pickle and sauce.

name: Oyster Po' Boy on a Bun
steps: Dip the oysters in egg, then almond flour and seasoning.
Pan-fry in oil until golden, about 2 minutes a side.
Toast the buns and fill with oysters, lettuce, tomato and mayo.

name: Cajun Chicken Pasta
steps: Sear the seasoned chicken in oil and slice.
Soften the pepper, mushrooms and garlic.
Add the cream and parmesan and simmer 3 minutes.
Toss with the pasta and chicken.

name: Creole Shrimp and Okra Stew
steps: Soften the onion, pepper and garlic in oil.
Add the okra, tomatoes and seasoning and simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in the shrimp and cook 4 minutes.

name: Collard Greens with Smoked Turkey Wing Style
steps: Crisp the bacon with onion and garlic.
Add the chopped collards, broth and pepper flakes.
Simmer 45 minutes and finish with vinegar.

name: Fried Okra, Oven-Baked
steps: Slice the okra.
Dip in egg, then the almond flour mix.
Roast on an oiled tray at 425°F for 25 minutes, turning once.

name: Southern Cabbage and Sausage Skillet
steps: Brown the sliced sausage in oil.
Add the onion and garlic, then the cabbage and broth.
Cook covered 15 minutes and finish with vinegar.

name: Black-Eyed Pea Salad (Texas Caviar)
steps: Combine the peas, corn, pepper, onion and jalapeno.
Dress with vinegar, oil and lime and fold in cilantro.
Chill an hour before serving.

name: Southern Chicken Salad with Pecans and Apple
steps: Shred the chicken and mix with celery, apple and pecans.
Bind with yogurt, mayo, mustard and lemon.
Serve over the greens.

name: Tomato Pie-Style Baked Tomatoes
steps: Slice the tomatoes and layer in a dish.
Mix the cheeses, mayo and basil and spread on top.
Bake at 375°F for 25 minutes.

name: Pimento-Style Cheese Celery Boats
steps: Mix the grated cheddar, cream cheese, chopped red pepper, mayo and seasoning.
Fill celery stalks.

name: Georgia Peach Cottage Cheese Cup
steps: Spoon the cottage cheese into cups.
Top with sliced peach, pecans, cinnamon and vanilla.

name: Low-Country Boil
steps: Bring the water to a boil with Old Bay, lemon, onion and garlic.
Add the potatoes and cook 10 minutes, then the sausage and corn for 8.
Add the shrimp for the last 3 minutes and drain.

name: She-Crab-Style Soup (Lightened)
steps: Soften the onion and celery in butter.
Add the broth and milk and simmer 10 minutes.
Stir in the crab, Old Bay and lemon and heat gently.

name: Carolina Pulled Pork Plate with Vinegar Slaw
steps: Use cooked, shredded pork shoulder; toss with half the vinegar, pepper flakes, paprika and salt.
Toss the slaw with the rest of the vinegar and the oil.
Serve the pork with slaw and boiled potatoes.

name: Southern Green Beans with New Potatoes
steps: Crisp the bacon with the onion.
Add the beans, potatoes and broth.
Simmer covered 30 minutes.

name: Deviled Egg Salad Stuffed Tomatoes
steps: Hard-boil the eggs and chop.
Mix with yogurt, mustard, celery and chives.
Hollow out the tomatoes and fill; dust with paprika.

name: Chicken and Sausage Jambalaya Soup
steps: Simmer the chicken, onion, pepper and celery in the broth and tomatoes for 20 minutes.
Shred the chicken, add the sliced sausage, rice and seasoning and cook 8 minutes.

name: Cajun Shrimp Stuffed Avocado
steps: Season the shrimp and sear in oil, 2 minutes a side.
Halve the avocados.
Fill with shrimp, onion and cilantro and squeeze lime on top.

name: Peach Pecan Overnight Oats
steps: Stir the oats, milk, yogurt, chia and cinnamon in a jar.
Refrigerate overnight.
Top with peach and pecans.

name: Texas-Style Beef Chili without Beans
steps: Brown the cubed beef in oil.
Add the onion, garlic, jalapeno and spices.
Stir in the tomatoes, paste and broth and simmer 80 minutes until tender.

name: Brisket-Style Slow Cooker Beef with Barbecue Rub
steps: Rub the beef with the spice mix.
Place on the onion in a slow cooker with the broth and vinegar.
Cook on low for 8 hours and shred or slice.

name: Smoked Turkey Breast with Dry Rub
steps: Rub the turkey with oil, vinegar and the spices.
Roast at 300°F, or smoke, until it reaches 165°F, about 2 hours.
Rest and slice.

name: Barbecue Ribs, Oven-Baked
steps: Rub the pork with the spices.
Wrap tightly and bake at 300°F for 2 hours.
Brush with a sauce of paste, vinegar and sweetener and finish under the broiler.

name: BBQ Chicken Quarters with Corn on the Cob
steps: Whisk the paste, vinegar, paprika and sweetener.
Roast the chicken at 425°F for 35 minutes, brushing with sauce.
Grill or boil the corn and brush with butter.

name: Cowboy Caviar Chicken Bowls
steps: Season and grill the chicken, then slice.
Mix the beans, corn, pepper, onion, lime and cilantro.
Serve over rice with chicken and avocado.

name: Tex-Mex Chicken Tortilla Soup
steps: Simmer the chicken, onion, tomatoes, spices and broth for 20 minutes.
Shred the chicken and add the beans and corn.
Serve with strips of crisped tortilla, avocado and cilantro.

name: Carne Asada Street Tacos
steps: Marinate the steak in lime, garlic and cumin for 30 minutes.
Grill 4 minutes a side, rest and chop.
Warm the tortillas and fill with steak, onion, cilantro and salsa.

name: Chicken Tinga Tostadas
steps: Poach and shred the chicken.
Simmer with chipotle, tomato sauce and onion for 10 minutes.
Crisp the tortillas in a hot oven.
Top with beans, chicken, lettuce and cotija.

name: Fish Tostadas with Lime Cabbage
steps: Season the tilapia and pan-sear 3 minutes a side.
Crisp the tortillas in the oven.
Toss the cabbage with lime and yogurt.
Top the tostadas with fish, slaw and avocado.

name: Taco Soup
steps: Brown the beef with the onion.
Add the beans, corn, tomatoes, broth and taco seasoning and simmer 20 minutes.
Top with cheddar.

name: Tamale Pie Casserole
steps: Brown the turkey with the onion and chili powder; stir in beans, corn and sauce.
Stir the egg into the cooked grits for the crust.
Spread the filling in a dish, cover with grits and cheddar.
Bake at 375°F for 30 minutes.

name: Midwest Hotdish with Ground Beef and Green Beans
steps: Brown the beef with the onion and mushrooms.
Stir in the beans, milk and thyme.
Top with sliced potatoes and cheddar and bake at 375°F for 40 minutes.

name: Chicken and Wild Rice Soup
steps: Simmer the chicken, vegetables and thyme in the broth for 25 minutes.
Shred the chicken and add the cooked wild rice and milk.
Heat through gently.

name: Bratwurst-Style Turkey Sausage with Sauerkraut and Apple
steps: Brown the sausages in oil.
Add the onion and apple and cook until soft.
Warm the sauerkraut with them and serve with mustard.

name: Cheese Curd-Style Baked Cauliflower Bites
steps: Toss the florets in egg and almond flour.
Roast on an oiled tray at 425°F for 20 minutes.
Top with mozzarella for the last 5.

name: New England Baked Cod with Herb Crumbs
steps: Crumb the bread and mix with melted butter, parsley and garlic.
Top the cod and bake at 400°F for 15 minutes.
Serve with lemon and steamed green beans.

name: Lobster Roll Lettuce Wraps
steps: Chop the cooked lobster.
Mix with celery, mayo, yogurt, lemon and chives.
Spoon into lettuce leaves.

name: Maine-Style Lobster Roll on a Toasted Bun
steps: Toss the cooked lobster with lemon, chives and celery.
Toast the buns in butter.
Fill generously.

name: Boston Baked Beans without Molasses
steps: Combine everything in a pot.
Bake covered at 300°F for 2 hours, adding water as needed.

name: Cape Cod Turkey Burger with Cranberry Mustard
steps: Mix the turkey with chopped cranberries and salt and shape four patties.
Pan-sear 6 minutes a side.
Toast the buns and spread with mustard.
Build with arugula and onion.

name: Hawaiian Chicken Skewers with Pineapple
steps: Marinate the chicken in soy sauce, ginger, garlic and sesame oil.
Thread onto skewers with pineapple, pepper and onion.
Grill 10 to 12 minutes and serve over rice.

name: Poke Bowl with Tuna and Cucumber
steps: Cube the tuna and toss with soy sauce and sesame oil.
Divide the rice among bowls.
Top with tuna, cucumber, avocado, green onion, sesame seeds and nori.

name: Kalua-Style Pork with Cabbage
steps: Rub the pork with salt and paprika.
Slow cook with the water for 8 hours.
Shred and stir in the steamed cabbage.

name: Pacific Northwest Cedar-Style Salmon with Asparagus
steps: Brush the salmon with mustard, oil, garlic and dill.
Roast at 400°F for 15 minutes with the asparagus.
Serve with lemon.

name: Seattle-Style Teriyaki Chicken Plate
steps: Sear the chicken in oil, then glaze with soy sauce, ginger, garlic, vinegar and sweetener.
Steam or sauté the cabbage.
Serve with rice.

name: California Cobb Burrito Bowl
steps: Grill and slice the chicken; boil and slice the eggs; crisp the bacon.
Arrange everything over the romaine.
Dress with lime and oil.

name: San Diego Shrimp Ceviche Cups
steps: Poach the shrimp 2 minutes, chop and chill.
Marinate in the lime juice for 20 minutes.
Fold in tomato, cucumber, onion, jalapeno and cilantro.
Serve with avocado.

name: Southwest Stuffed Peppers with Turkey and Rice
steps: Halve the peppers and parboil 4 minutes.
Brown the turkey with the spices; mix with rice, beans and tomatoes.
Fill the peppers, top with cheddar and bake at 375°F for 25 minutes.

name: Egg Drop Soup
steps: Bring the broth and ginger to a simmer and whisk in the arrowroot slurry.
Pour in the beaten egg in a thin stream while stirring.
Finish with green onion, sesame oil and pepper.

name: Hot and Sour Soup
steps: Simmer the broth with the mushrooms, soy sauce and pepper.
Add the tofu and arrowroot slurry.
Stir in the beaten egg and finish with vinegar and green onion.

name: Baked General Tso-Style Chicken
steps: Toss the cubed chicken in egg and arrowroot and bake on an oiled tray at 425°F for 15 minutes.
Simmer the soy sauce, vinegar, garlic, ginger, pepper flakes and sweetener for 3 minutes.
Toss with the chicken and steamed broccoli.

name: Orange Chicken with Fresh Juice
steps: Toss the cubed chicken in arrowroot and sear in oil until golden.
Simmer the orange juice, soy sauce, vinegar, garlic and ginger to a glaze.
Coat the chicken and serve with broccoli and green onion.

name: Kung Pao Chicken with Peanuts
steps: Sear the chicken in oil.
Add the pepper, zucchini, garlic, ginger and pepper flakes.
Stir in the soy sauce, vinegar and arrowroot slurry and finish with peanuts and sesame oil.

name: Sweet and Sour Chicken with Pineapple
steps: Sear the cubed chicken in oil.
Add the pepper and onion, then a sauce of paste, vinegar and sweetener thickened with arrowroot.
Fold in the pineapple and serve over rice.

name: Chicken Lo Mein with Vegetables
steps: Boil the noodles and drain.
Stir-fry the sliced chicken in oil, add the vegetables, garlic and ginger.
Toss with the noodles, soy sauce and sesame oil.

name: Shrimp with Snow Peas and Garlic Sauce
steps: Sear the shrimp in oil and set aside.
Stir-fry the peas, mushrooms and garlic.
Add the soy sauce, vinegar and arrowroot slurry and return the shrimp.

name: Mongolian-Style Beef with Scallions
steps: Slice the steak thin and toss in arrowroot.
Sear in oil in two batches.
Add garlic, ginger, soy sauce and sweetener, then the green onion.
Serve over cauliflower rice.

name: Egg Foo Young
steps: Mix the beaten eggs with sprouts, shrimp, green onion and mushrooms.
Pan-fry small patties in oil, 2 minutes a side.
Simmer the broth, soy sauce and arrowroot into a gravy and spoon over.

name: Moo Shu Chicken Lettuce Wraps
steps: Stir-fry the sliced chicken in oil.
Add the vegetables and ginger, then push aside and scramble the eggs.
Season with soy sauce and sesame oil and spoon into lettuce.

name: Vegetable Fried Rice with Egg
steps: Stir-fry garlic, carrot and peas in oil.
Scramble the eggs in the pan.
Add the cold rice, soy sauce and sesame oil and finish with green onion.

name: Pork and Cabbage Stir-Fry
steps: Brown the pork with garlic and ginger in oil.
Add the cabbage and carrot and stir-fry 5 minutes.
Season with soy sauce and sesame oil and top with green onion.

name: Chicken Marsala
steps: Dust the chicken with arrowroot and sear in oil.
Brown the mushrooms with garlic in butter.
Add wine and broth, return the chicken and simmer 10 minutes.

name: Spaghetti Carbonara
steps: Cook the spaghetti.
Crisp the bacon with the garlic.
Whisk the eggs with parmesan and pepper.
Toss with the hot pasta off the heat until creamy.

name: Pasta Primavera
steps: Cook the pasta.
Sauté the vegetables and garlic in oil.
Toss together with parmesan and basil.

name: Stuffed Shells with Ricotta and Spinach
steps: Cook the shells al dente.
Mix the ricotta, wilted spinach, egg, parmesan and garlic.
Fill the shells, set on marinara in a dish and top with mozzarella.
Bake at 375°F for 25 minutes.

name: Pasta e Fagioli
steps: Sauté the onion, carrot, celery and garlic in oil.
Add the tomatoes, broth, beans and seasoning and simmer 15 minutes.
Add the pasta and cook until tender.

name: Italian Wedding Soup
steps: Mix the turkey, egg, parmesan and garlic and roll tiny meatballs.
Simmer the broth and carrot, drop in the meatballs for 10 minutes.
Add the pasta and spinach and cook until tender.

name: Antipasto Salad
steps: Chop the romaine and arrange on a platter.
Add the turkey, mozzarella, artichokes, peppers, olives and tomatoes.
Dress with vinegar and oil.

name: Caprese Chicken Skillet
steps: Sear the chicken in oil, 5 minutes a side.
Add the garlic and tomatoes and cook 4 minutes.
Top with mozzarella to melt and finish with basil and balsamic.

name: Eggplant Rollatini
steps: Slice the eggplant lengthwise and roast until pliable.
Spread with the ricotta and spinach mixture and roll.
Cover with marinara and cheeses and bake at 375°F for 20 minutes.

name: Zuppa Toscana-Style Soup
steps: Brown the sausage with the onion and garlic.
Add the broth, potatoes and pepper flakes and simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in the kale and cream and cook 5 minutes.

name: Gyro Chicken Bowls with Tzatziki
steps: Marinate the chicken in oil, lemon and oregano and grill; slice.
Stir the yogurt with grated cucumber, garlic and lemon.
Build bowls from rice, chicken, tomato, onion and feta with tzatziki.

name: Greek Diner Omelet with Feta and Spinach
steps: Sauté the spinach and tomato in oil.
Add the beaten eggs and cook until nearly set.
Top with feta and oregano and fold.

name: Butter Chicken with Cauliflower Rice
steps: Brown the chicken in butter.
Add the onion, garlic, ginger and spices, then the tomato sauce.
Simmer 15 minutes and stir in the cream.
Serve over cauliflower rice.

name: Herb-Roasted Turkey Breast with Pan Gravy
steps: Rub the turkey with butter, herbs, garlic and salt and set on the onion.
Roast at 350°F until 165°F, about 90 minutes, adding broth to the pan.
Strain the juices, thicken with arrowroot into a gravy and slice.

name: Bread Stuffing with Celery and Sage
steps: Cube and dry the bread.
Sauté the onion and celery in butter with the herbs.
Toss with the bread, broth and egg.
Bake covered at 350°F for 30 minutes, uncovered for 10.

name: Cranberry Sauce with Orange (Low Sugar)
steps: Simmer everything for 10 to 12 minutes until the berries pop.
Cool; it thickens as it chills.

name: Pumpkin Custard (Crustless Pie)
steps: Whisk everything together.
Pour into a greased dish.
Bake at 350°F for 45 to 50 minutes until set.

name: Roasted Brussels Sprouts with Pecans and Cranberries
steps: Roast the halved sprouts with oil and salt at 425°F for 20 minutes.
Toss with pecans, cranberries and balsamic.

name: Mashed Cauliflower and Potato
steps: Boil the cauliflower and potatoes until tender.
Mash with butter, milk and garlic.
Top with chives.

name: Thyme Roasted Carrots
steps: Roast the carrots with oil and thyme at 425°F for 30 minutes.

name: Glazed Ham Steak with Pineapple
steps: Sear the ham steaks in oil.
Brush with mustard and vinegar and top with pineapple.
Broil 3 minutes.

name: Sweet Potato Mash with Cinnamon
steps: Boil the sweet potatoes until soft.
Mash with butter, milk, cinnamon and salt.

name: Turkey Pot Pie Casserole with Cauliflower Topping
steps: Simmer the turkey, vegetables, broth, milk and thyme and thicken with arrowroot.
Spread in a dish.
Top with mashed cauliflower and cheddar and bake at 375°F for 25 minutes.

name: Chicken Divan Casserole
steps: Arrange the chicken and steamed broccoli in a dish.
Stir the yogurt, milk, mayo, curry powder and lemon and pour over.
Top with cheddar and bake at 375°F for 30 minutes.

name: Baked Spaghetti Casserole
steps: Brown the beef with the onion and stir in the marinara.
Mix the pasta with cottage cheese and half the sauce in a dish.
Top with the rest and cheeses and bake at 375°F for 30 minutes.

name: King Ranch Chicken Casserole (Lightened)
steps: Mix the shredded chicken, chiles, pepper and onion with the yogurt, broth and chili powder.
Layer with torn tortillas in a dish.
Top with cheddar and bake at 375°F for 30 minutes.

name: Hamburger Helper-Style Skillet with Whole Pasta
steps: Brown the beef with the onion.
Add the tomato sauce, broth and spices and bring to a simmer.
Stir in the cooked pasta and cheddar until melted.

name: Stuffed Acorn Squash with Sausage and Apple
steps: Halve and roast the squash at 400°F for 30 minutes.
Brown the sausage with onion, apple and sage.
Fill the squash and top with pecans; return to the oven for 10 minutes.

name: Pork Tenderloin with Apple Cider Glaze
steps: Sear the pork in oil.
Roast at 400°F for 15 minutes with the apple and green beans.
Brush with mustard and vinegar and rest before slicing.

name: Rosemary Lamb Chops with Roasted Vegetables
steps: Rub the chops with rosemary, garlic and oil.
Roast with the vegetables at 425°F for 18 to 20 minutes.
Finish with lemon.

name: Standing Rib-Style Roast with Horseradish Yogurt
steps: Rub the roast with oil, garlic, rosemary, pepper and salt.
Roast at 325°F to 130°F inside for medium rare.
Rest 20 minutes and slice; serve with yogurt mixed with mustard.

name: Baked Salmon with Dijon and Dill
steps: Brush the salmon with mustard and oil.
Bake at 400°F for 12 to 15 minutes.
Finish with dill and lemon.

name: Seafood Chowder with Potatoes
steps: Crisp the bacon, soften the onion and celery.
Add the broth, potatoes and thyme and simmer 12 minutes.
Add the milk and seafood and cook 6 minutes.

name: Spinach and Mushroom Quiche without Crust
steps: Sauté the onion, mushrooms and spinach in oil.
Whisk the eggs, milk and nutmeg and pour over the vegetables and cheese in a dish.
Bake at 350°F for 30 to 35 minutes.

name: Holiday Cheese and Veggie Platter
steps: Slice the cheeses and vegetables.
Arrange on a platter with olives and hummus.

name: Shrimp Cocktail with Horseradish Tomato Sauce
steps: Poach the shrimp 3 minutes and chill.
Stir the paste, lemon juice, hot sauce and mustard into a sauce.
Serve with lemon.

name: Bacon-Wrapped Dates, Small Portion
steps: Stuff each date with an almond.
Wrap with a strip of bacon.
Bake at 400°F for 18 to 20 minutes.

name: Pumpkin Soup with Toasted Pepitas
steps: Sauté the onion and garlic in oil.
Add the pumpkin, broth and spice and simmer 15 minutes.
Blend with the cream and top with pepitas.

name: Apple Cinnamon Baked Oatmeal
steps: Mix the oats, milk, eggs, cinnamon, baking powder and vanilla.
Fold in the chopped apple and walnuts.
Bake at 350°F for 30 to 35 minutes.

name: Gingerbread Spiced Chia Pudding
steps: Whisk everything.
Chill at least 4 hours.

name: Turkey and Cheese Pinwheels
steps: Spread the tortillas with cream cheese.
Layer turkey, spinach and cheddar.
Roll tight and slice into rounds.

name: Mini Meatloaf Muffins
steps: Mix everything and press into a muffin tin.
Brush with a little paste.
Bake at 375°F for 22 to 25 minutes.

name: Chicken Nuggets, Baked with Almond Crumb
steps: Cut the chicken into nuggets.
Dip in egg, then almond flour mixed with parmesan and spices.
Bake on an oiled tray at 425°F for 15 to 18 minutes.

name: Fish Sticks, Baked
steps: Cut the cod into sticks.
Dip in egg, then almond flour, parmesan and Old Bay.
Bake at 425°F for 12 to 15 minutes.
Serve with lemon yogurt dip.

name: Cheese Quesadilla Triangles
steps: Fill half of each tortilla with cheddar and beans and fold.
Crisp in a pan with oil.
Cut into triangles.

name: Ants on a Log
steps: Fill the celery stalks with peanut butter.
Press seeds on top.

name: Banana Dog Roll-Up
steps: Spread the tortillas with peanut butter.
Place a banana on each and roll.

name: Pizza Pasta Bake
steps: Brown the sausage; mix with the cooked pasta, marinara, pepper and seasoning.
Top with mozzarella.
Bake at 375°F for 20 minutes.

name: Cheeseburger Soup
steps: Brown the beef with the onion and carrot.
Add the potatoes, broth, mustard and paste and simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in the milk and cheddar.

name: Peanut Butter Banana Quesadilla
steps: Spread peanut butter and banana on half of each tortilla.
Fold and toast in a pan 2 minutes a side.

name: Scrambled Egg Muffin Cups with Ham
steps: Divide the chopped ham, pepper and spinach among six muffin cups.
Pour in the beaten eggs and top with cheddar.
Bake at 350°F for 18 to 20 minutes.

name: Yogurt-Dipped Frozen Berries
steps: Stir the vanilla into the yogurt.
Dip the berries and freeze on a tray 2 hours.

name: Lunchbox Turkey Bento with Cheddar Roll-Ups and Blueberries
steps: Roll the turkey around cheddar sticks.
Pack with cucumber, blueberries, almonds and crackers.

name: Sloppy Joes on Hamburger Buns
steps: Brown the beef with the onion and pepper.
Add the sauce, mustard, vinegar and chili powder and simmer 12 minutes.
Spoon onto toasted buns.

name: Mac and Cheese Cups with Hidden Cauliflower
steps: Boil the pasta and cauliflower together; mash the cauliflower.
Stir with the cheddar, milk and egg.
Spoon into muffin cups and bake at 375°F for 15 minutes.

name: Taco Pizza on a Tortilla
steps: Brown the turkey with taco seasoning.
Crisp the tortillas, top with turkey and cheddar and bake 6 minutes.
Add tomato, lettuce and salsa.

name: Pigs in a Blanket with Turkey Franks
steps: Cut the tortillas into strips.
Wrap around cheese-topped sausage pieces.
Bake at 400°F for 15 minutes and serve with mustard.

name: Apple Nachos with Peanut Butter and Pecans
steps: Slice the apples thin on a plate.
Drizzle with warmed peanut butter.
Scatter with pecans, chocolate and cinnamon.

name: Peanut Butter Oat Energy Bites
steps: Mix everything.
Chill 20 minutes.
Roll into twelve balls.

name: Hummus and Veggie Snack Cups
steps: Spoon hummus into four cups.
Stand the cut vegetables in each.

name: Homemade Chicken Noodle Cups
steps: Simmer the chicken, carrot and celery in the broth for 12 minutes.
Shred the chicken, add the noodles and cook until tender.

name: Corn Dog Muffins with Turkey Franks
steps: Mix the cooked grits with egg, milk, cheddar and baking powder.
Press into muffin cups around sausage pieces.
Bake at 375°F for 18 to 20 minutes.

name: Cinnamon Apple Quesadilla
steps: Cook the thin apple slices with cinnamon and butter 3 minutes.
Fill half of each tortilla with apple and cheddar and fold.
Toast 2 minutes a side.

name: Chocolate Banana Frozen Yogurt Pops
steps: Blend everything.
Pour into pop moulds and freeze 4 hours.

name: Cheesy Broccoli Rice Cups
steps: Mix the cooked rice, chopped broccoli, cheddar, egg and milk.
Press into muffin cups.
Bake at 375°F for 20 minutes.

name: Egg Salad Lettuce Cups for Lunch
steps: Hard-boil and chop the eggs.
Mix with yogurt, mustard, celery and chives.
Spoon into lettuce cups and dust with paprika.
